author: TheEaterOfDoooom
body:
This is probably my first post and everything, great server btw. This is the right section for suggestions, right?

Now, on CTH the scout is a very usefull class, because it has the same equipment as the basic class but obviously has speed II aswell. But on Nexus, it has a weaker weapon than the basic class, meaning that getting kills with it is very dificult. I suggest that it gets an iron sword, but has the helmet and chestplate removed.

Jakesandobal haste makes you swing faster visually, but really it's just about how fast you can click anyway.
